headline: Trump, Putin and Xi to Hold Historic Nuclear Talks in China
facebook_description: Trump, Putin and Xi are scheduled to meet November 19 in Shenzhen, China. Washington plans to raise nuclear arms reductions after the expiration of New START. Beijing has not agreed to a new arms-control framework. Can the three leaders establish a path toward nuclear stability? Follow EP News for updates. #WorldNews #NuclearTalks #EPNews
